title: Saturation genome editing of XRCC2 scores
methodText: Functional scores for SNVs and 3-bp deletions were calculated by applying a negative binomial regression model to variant counts across all sampled time points and replicates. Variants near 0 represent no change, loss of function variants have progressively more negative scores.
abstractText: Systematic interrogation of the functional consequences of variants of uncertain significance (VUS) is critical to interpretation of clinical genetic testing.  We applied Saturation Genome Editing (SGE) to assess  SNVs and in-frame deletions for their effect of cell survival.
shortDescription: We used saturation genome editing to measure the effect of SNVs and 3-base pair deletions on XRCC2-dependent HAP1 cell survival
